limitations: Preparation tests intentionally never return; force-stop interrupts the live process after ready. Their expected interruption is not counted as JUnit success.
Controlled am force-stop is verified, not low-memory-killer or OEM automatic lifecycle behavior.

All five secondary records have pidBeforeKill=null: the first verification process had already exited normally. These are five new cold launches, not five additional live-process kills; the legacy secondDeath raw record is retained and interpreted in betweenRecoveries.
Structured rules/proxies/groups saves enter the formal MainActivity ViewModel; local node save and exit use Compose clicks. Not all cases are complete user-navigation E2E.
Committed checkpoints are after Repository complete file/Room return and before manager application/UI cleanup. No claim about a crash inside file/Room transaction atomicity.

Parent clear cases open only the parent editor; simultaneous parent close with an already-started structured save is not independently covered. Local directory death cases use node saves, not every bulk operation kind.
Local close-after checkpoint only fires after an actually referenced CUSTOM input finishes applyCurrentProfile. Core remains STOPPED; no running VPN/network traffic claim.
This batch does not rerun Provider networks, Flutter visual parity, low API, Go, signed Release runtime, remote CI or publication.

Build1 failed missing test canWrite parameter; build3 failed packageRelease with unspecified IncrementalSplitterRunnable. Build4 retry succeeded without source changes; first packaging root cause remains unknown. Build5 includes the corrected no-replay assertion. windows2 completed 13 cases, then parent-close-before preparation found automatic writer could clear before the explicit close checkpoint; build7 covers both writers at the real clear boundary. Unready parent fixture cleanup is recorded separately. windows1 completed 11 cases but local-close-before verification failed because core input loading was incorrectly treated as exit replay; retained separately and not added to final totals.
Raw APKs/logs/source snapshots are local persistent attachments outside Git; remote readers cannot recover them from local paths alone.
